verified_title: A JEPA-Based Field-Layer World Model for Bridging Channel Prediction and Estimation
metadata_description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2608.10222: A JEPA-Based Field-Layer World Model for Bridging Channel Prediction and Estimation
method_summary: A shared propagation state connects different CSI formats through physical paths, delays, angles, visibility/blockage and spatial covariance. Format-specific tokenizers feed a shared latent field trained with masked EMA prediction, diversity regularization and multi-scale alignment.
direct_overlap: phase/visibility-aware interpretation of native radio state
evidence_and_limits: Channel estimation/prediction and beamforming targets; does not demonstrate a packet-deadline or roaming controller. Phase-sensitive coefficients are not claimed to be universally invariant.
